name: universal-office
description: Suíte Universal Office — editor de texto (Write), planilha eletrônica (Sheet) e apresentação (Slides) com compatibilidade de formato (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx) e renderização fiel.

scripts.install:all: npm run install:converter && npm install --prefix write && npm install --prefix sheet && npm install --prefix slides
scripts.install:converter: npm install --no-save --package-lock=false --prefix vendor/office-converter && npm run build --prefix vendor/office-converter
scripts.build: npm run build:converter && npm run build:write && npm run build:sheet && npm run build:slides
scripts.test: npm run test:write && npm run test:sheet && npm run test:slides
